upcoming.title: Using Mural Cloth Seminar
upcoming.body:
Beyond The Walls: Street Art Summit

Skill Building Seminar

Early Bird Discount: $22* (buy before October 25, 2026)
General Admission: $25
Members: $22

BUY TICKETS

Led by artist Nicole Buchholz, discover the process of creating large-scale artwork on mural cloth, a professional-grade material used for permanent indoor and outdoor murals. Also known as polytab or parachute cloth, this durable surface allows for vibrant color, fine detail, and collaborative public art projects.

In this presentation and demonstration, the Artist shares the complete mural cloth process—from preparation and priming to design transfer, painting, installation, common pitfalls to avoid, and maintenance. Participants will gain practical skills, project-planning strategies, and an understanding of how professional muralists successfully execute large-scale mural projects using mural cloth.

Accessibility Options - BMoCA and Street Wise Arts are committed to making our programs accessible to all. To request an accessibility accommodation including ASL interpretation, please contact Education@bmoca.org at least 7 days prior to the program. We will make every effort to accommodate requests.

Instructor: Nicole Buchholz

Nicole is an urban planner and muralist behind SolRaya Public Space, specializing in joyful, inclusive public-space activation. She has co-led neighborhood pool transformations in Philadelphia and Baltimore, designed and painted murals throughout South Baltimore, and presented on public engagement and co-design at national conferences. Inspired by her Mexican and Venezuelan heritage and travels through Central and South America, her work reflects vibrant colors and patterns. She brings a whimsical, bright and bold style.
https://www.solrayapublicspace.com/

upcoming.filename: IG Beyond the Walls Bus of Murals.png
upcoming.title: Business of Murals 101 Workshop
upcoming.body:
Beyond The Walls: Street Art Summit

Early Bird Discount: $22* (buy before October 25, 2026)
General Admission: $25
Members: $22

BUY TICKETS

Business of Murals 101 Workshop is a practical, behind-the-scenes seminar about the mural industry led by mural artist DETOUR.

Participants will explore the full mural process, from developing a personal style and translating designs onto large-scale surfaces to selecting materials, preparing walls, choosing equipment, managing timelines, and planning for maintenance. The workshop also covers the business side of mural work, including how to price projects, evaluate creative and logistical considerations, communicate with clients, and develop effective proposals for commissions and public art opportunities.

Through real-world mural case studies and drawing on more than a decade of experience creating large-scale public and private murals around the world, Detour will share insights into budgets, production timelines, creative freedom, client relationships, and the many different ways mural projects can take shape from concept to completion.

The session concludes with a dedicated Q&A for artists looking to strengthen their mural practice, refine their process, and pursue larger-scale opportunities.

Accessibility Options - BMoCA and Street Wise Arts are committed to making our programs accessible to all. To request an accessibility accommodation including ASL interpretation, please contact Education@bmoca.org at least 7 days prior to the program. We will make every effort to accommodate requests.

Instructor Bio: DETOUR
Thomas Evans, a.k.a. DETOUR, is a multidisciplinary artist specializing in large-scale public art, interactive visuals, portraiture, immersive spaces, and creative direction. His work explores the intersection of art and innovation, blending traditional mediums with emerging technologies and collaborative approaches. A natural collaborator and self-described “military brat,” DETOUR draws from a wide range of experiences that shape his creative perspective. His ever-evolving practice spans visual art, music, and interactive technology, challenging conventional notions of creativity and expanding the boundaries of fine art. At the heart of his work is a belief in opening up the creative process—moving beyond the singular artist to create experiences shaped by collaboration, participation, and audience engagement. https://www.iamdetour.com/

upcoming.title: Street Art Summit Movie Night
upcoming.body:
Beyond The Walls: Street Art Summit

Early Bird Discount: $9* (buy before October 25, 2026)
General Admission: $10
Members: $8

BUY TICKETS

JUST ADDED! - the film’s director, Alexandra Henry, will be in attendance and there will be a Q&A after the movie.

BMoCA & Street Wise Arts present a welcoming, community-centered space to gather, connect, and explore the power of murals through a film screening and networking event celebrating women in Street Art. Street Heroines is an award-winning feature-length documentary celebrating the courage and creativity of women who despite their lack of recognition have been an integral part of the graffiti and street art movement since the beginning.

A bastion of female empowerment, Street Heroines gives visibility to fearless artists who create their own opportunities in the name of women’s rights, gender and economic equality, increased accessibility to the arts, and the celebration of cultural identity. More info here.

Come watch. Come connect. Come be part of the conversation and network with SWA, Kiss Fist, Babe Walls and FCMP.

Because public art is more than what we see on the wall—it’s about the stories, voices, and communities behind it.

Doors open at 6pm. Film starts at 7pm (running time 1.5 hours). Cash bar and light snacks. The movie will be shown with closed captioning. ASL interpreters will be on site for this event.

This event's ASL interpreter is supported by Street Wise Arts through the Colorado Creates grant, funded by Colorado Creative Industries and the National Endowment for the Arts.

past.title: Time and Other Materials Film Screening
past.body:
Join us for a screening of the film, Time and Other Materials, a captivating exploration into the minds and hearts of five accomplished artists, followed by a panel discussion with the featured artists. Seating is very limited in the Boedecker Theater at the Dairy Arts Center.

Cost: $14/$11 seniors & students
7:00pm BUY TICKETS

Each with their unique perspective and medium - be it animation, ceramics, installation art, or large-scale sculpture - they unveil their inner worlds through a series of intimate studio sessions. This revealing documentary delves into their collective need to create and connect, not only with each other but with the broader world and beyond. Emphasizing themes such as discovery, mystery, femininity, and the vision of a better future, the film illustrates what it truly means to live a life devoted to creativity. Through five individual chapters filled with personal reflections and artistic processes, the documentary highlights the profound significance of art for both its creators and audience. More info here.

Featuring artists Stacey Steers, Rebecca DiDomenico, Kim Dickey, Martha Russo, Ana María Hernando. Produced and Directed by Amie Knox & Chad Herschberger.

In partnership with The Nature Conservancy and the Boulder Museum of Contemporary Art.
